meta.name: linkedin-brand-direction
meta.description: Turn your real LinkedIn network plus your goal into a personalised, algorithm-aware content direction. Trigger on "what should I post on LinkedIn", "what's my content lane", "give me a LinkedIn content direction", "what does my network reward", or after a power audit when the user wants a brand strategy. Reads the network composition from linkedin-power-audit's audit.json (or falls back to the network-scan.json composition), the person's stated goal, and the shared algorithm reference, then writes a defined-schema brand-direction.json that linkedin-post consumes. Every claim traces to a real fact in the user's own network - no generic tips, no invented numbers.
